note: Sources opened: Presser (Chen Yi), brightsheng.com work pages, IRCAM Brahms lists drawn from Schott/Ricordi (Takemitsu, Hosokawa, Fujikura), Faber Music (Sculthorpe, Vine), Wise Music (Tan Dun, Edwards), Wikipedia (Yun, Miyoshi, Butterfly Lovers). Not checkable: Boosey/OUP (Zhou Long, Yun) and Australian Music Centre (CAPTCHA, not bypassed), C.F. Peters (Ung), Zen-On (Miyoshi, Hisaishi). Joe Hisaishi and Chinary Ung: no original violin works found. Not covered: Sailors' Dance (composer not confirmed), Ma Sicong Violin Concerto in F (1944) and further Ma Sicong pieces (catalogue already has 4 Ma Sicong entries; Wikipedia only), Akira Nishimura Violin Concertos Nos. 1-2 (Boosey listing seen but not opened), Sheng Zhongguo. Wikipedia gives Chen Gang's dates as 10 March 1935 - 18 July 2026. Sheng's work list spells the 2022 piece 'Rage of Love' (home page: 'Rages of Love'). Several durations, years and editions are blank where unconfirmed; confidence 'low' entries rest on Wikipedia or recordings only. Existing 138 Chinese Folk Dance Suite is 20 min per Presser; existing 799 and 1424 are consistent with Presser.
